facts.fact: 惊讶=不 see it coming——事件出乎意料地发生、发生中未及命名；无先行词的代词在此恰切（apropos）；名字得 grow some legs 才能 hurry 去 catch up；例：笑话的 punch line（明知有此一句但此刻此句没预见）；友人来访——不是他来 catch you off guard 而是 popped in without calling first 且正值晚饭中间；婚姻终结——two spouses 知必有一人先走，但妻子没料到丈夫 pull a Bertrand Russell——骑车外出、忽悟不爱妻子、回来要求离婚；surprise 与 unfamiliar 之 springs upon 的方式与时机有关——breaking into、opening up the familiar

诸 surprise 多只短暂摄住注意（etymology of surprise：被超出或越过 thought 之外者 seize/arrest）；但有的告诉我们与新事物相遇的要义、有时关乎对自己的理解；inquiry 中的两类：perplex（以为知此于己者实则不知）与 illumination（得前所不能 grasp 的自知）；自然序列 perplexity 先于 illumination——除非先为某要事 bewildered 不能惊于自知之深浅；第一类表述：Before this inquiry, I knew for certain I was such and such（recluse）or this way of life was best（accomplishments 充盈的人生）or I acted thus（compassionately）——但 this question appearing at this moment 没预见、cast me into doubt——如今不确定是否这种人、是否如此行、此生是否最好——stirred up、turned about、bewildered

Elizabeth Bennett 在《傲慢与偏见》中心的宣言 Till now, I never knew myself——刚收 Darcy 信、fresh revelations arrest her；Taken aback：她对他人 characters 的道德评判原来基于对自己 self-worth 的 overvaluation、某些 cases 里 woefully inaccurate；尽管如此她渴望（不知如何）达于对己对人的 more considered view；bewilderment agitate 她、stir 起想 inquire 之欲——却不知 clear view 会是什么样、不知从何开始；其 plight 与 Meno 亦与我们相仿；perplexity 生 illumination 之欲；第二 surprise=flash of self-illumination：第一 inquiry 揭出 right question（我们 hunger 的那问）；而实际抵达的答案也没预见——guide 与 partner 同时认出这就是答案、同时 discover 关于被问者的同一事；谁都没料到 reasoning 会如此展开、也不知 conclusion 会大致或恰好在何处收尾

美好的 realization：nothing revealed can be taken back——事后每步可 reconsider/reconstruct、结论可 tied down 并 settle in；但在当下，我们以未有过的方式认出自己——其中 lightness 兼 joy；此 illumination 像 begin to get used to 一个新名字、或听见自己的名字被略不同地、更 resonantly and harmoniously 地发音

lightness 的培育：learn art of inquiry 使我们准备好面对生活 toss 来的 ordinary surprises；日常生活由 ordinary surprises 组成；untrained/unvigilant 者的反应像出自 our nature 深处的 reflex actions；一端：把意义强度沿 positive scale 抬太高——unwarranted jubilee/ebullience/elation/ecstasy——a trifle of a surprise gift 不该使我们 overjoyed 到 losing ourselves——仿佛 flourishing 太依赖 good fortune/latest news/good reputation；另一端：startled/shocked——event creeping up 到 threat 地位——disappointed/dismayed 或 frightened/horrified/paralyzed；两路皆失 allostasis——失 harmoniously respond to and play with things 之感；Ian Prinsloo：children positively hungry for surprises——成人却或 titillated/entranced（famished、找 a fix）或 turned off/cowed（不肯 taste/partake/join）

培育 properly/energetically/lightly responsive 之 character；apparent paradox：inquiring 教我们准备好对 we know not what 作出良好回应；其一：训练 suspend judgment、keep composure 当事件 runaway from anticipations；此 suspension 像 smiling softly、being in on a joke、reading Alice in Wonderland；lightness 在 stand back and take in 之能；其他 virtue 即刻被征用：courage——firm in the unknowing 而非逃；temperance——不 wish to be through straightaway；patience——taking our time 而非 rush/busy；discernment——何时 easy laugh with self and others；此乃 lifetime 之功 shining forth beautifully in an instant——getting the hang of living with lightness、taking more things in stride

不像 Kreon（Thebes 王、out of fury 监禁 Antigone）、不像 self-righteous 者（连把 surprise 看作 reflective 之召都不肯）、不像 diffident/meek 者（slink back from being tested）——我们要 bend like a reed without breaking；character 因 inquiry 愈壮则愈 buoyant/balletic/pliable/flexible；trained 者 ordinary surprise 不使我们 flinch or harden——而是 quietly urge us to search、lightheartedly to find that person in question—— ourselves

inquiring 源于 simple urge：知一点关于自己尚不知之事；unknowing 之感可以 I don't know 无限 repeat、可被否认拒绝、或经正当训练转化为 way of setting out——受邀冒险、一起 find something out；ordinary surprise 使 suspense 而 inquiry 使 in motion；发现已 adopt right vocabulary；现代世界的 errant vocabularies：人生如 problem to be solved/broken part to be fixed/illness 需 diagnosis 与 treatment/conditions to be coped with/opacity 需 expertise 之 address/monitor/manage；对照：inquiring 之词 simpler/direct/earnest——perplexed 时 better be puzzled/curious/nearly bemused 而非 preoccupied/obsessed；disinterestedly interested/fascinated/wry/adventuresome——问题无论多么 potent/stirling/bearing on life 皆可 impersonally/impartially 视之、viewed from above；此心近于 mathematician/curious child/engrossed reader of well-wrought novel——paying good attention=simply looking on；open to possible future states 而 without wishing；dispassionately following along、feeling one's way
facts.anchor: Inquiring springs from a simple human urge

facts.fact: 时代 unsettled——no time for smugness/unceasing doubt/cowardice；有人 smugly self-assured、有人 headlong 入 doubt、有人不敢 strike out——fellow inquirers 却可经 good fortune 与 good practice 移出 doubt 入 self-understanding；much to our surprise：最终 hit upon answers 时，right ones 会 stretch and enliven us、以 wider and wider circles illuminate our lives、让呼吸 ease、终于 rest 于 redolent of gentle amusement 之境——The right answer certainly feels like belonging in nearly every sense of the word
